verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs index (llms.txt) has a dedicated MCP entry describing MCP as a protocol for connecting models to data sources and tools. This sits alongside an Agents API with customizable tools and function calling to external tools, so MCP-client integration is plausibly supported. However, the evidence is only a one-line index summary and never shows how MCP servers are attached or which surfaces support it. Missing for 10: documented steps for connecting MCP servers (e.g. SDK/Agents API configuration or Le Chat connectors), supported transports/auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use.
